mapper.select: SELECT user_id, provider, provider_id, nickname, profile_image_url, email, birth_date FROM users WHERE provider = #{provider} AND provider_id = #{providerId}
SELECT user_id, provider, provider_id, nickname, profile_image_url, email, birth_date FROM users WHERE user_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( provider, provider_id, nickname, profile_image_url, email, birth_date, created_at, updated_at, last_login_at ) VALUES ( #{provider}, #{providerId}, #{nickname}, #{profileImage}, #{email}, #{birthDate}, NOW(), NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET nickname = #{nickname}, profile_image_url = #{profileImage}, email = #{email}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE provider = #{provider} AND provider_id = #{providerId}
